description.value:
Nebula instead grants resistance to all damage equal to your level until the start of your second subsequent turn. When you use it, also gain temporary Hit Points equal to your level for that duration. This replaces Nebula's resistance, shares its frequency, and does not grant a separate use. Apply Great Nebula instead of Nebula.

Effect: @UUID[Compendium.gunbreaker-pf2e.gunbreaker-effects.Item.2bf2c8bbde2e358d]{Great Nebula}.
